notes.title: Endless Mode | Traditional Chinese + improved Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
Hello workers, it’s update time! Here's what we've prepared for you:
[list]
[*]Endless Mode – a long-requested feature is now in the game.
[*]Traditional Chinese and improved Simplified Chinese localizations – huge thanks to our friend Andrzej Hsu (even the textures are translated!).
[*]Invert Y option – another highly requested feature is now available.
[*]Crashes in the later parts of the game have been fixed. If you're still experiencing any, please report them on the forums or via the support email.
[*]Other small bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
Thanks so much for your support. It means the world to our tiny team.

notes.title: Bug fixes (06.11.2024)
notes.content:

- Fixed bug when wrong ending being played

- Some small bug fixes and adjustments

notes.title: Bug fixes (05.11.2024)
notes.content:
- Fixed bug when game crashes on some PCs on Day 3 and Day ???

notes.title: Dollmare Now Available in Multiple Languages
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Dollmare is now available in multiple languages! Dive into the creepy doll factory experience in your preferred language and uncover the mysteries with ease.

Available languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]French
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and we hope this update enhances your journey into the world of Dollmare!
